correctness.rationale: Exact Fano incidence and graph-distance reconstruction gives 21 flags, 126 squared edges, and 511 nonempty cliques. The embedded explicit certificate has 231 disjoint matched codimension-one pairs and critical vector (1,0,48); the checker exhaustively verifies all 511 Hasse vertices in a directed topological sort, establishing a wedge of 48 integral two-spheres by discrete Morse theory. Independently verified binary boundary ranks are (20,106,84,21). The complete 168 color-preserving automorphisms, one explicit polarity, and its second 168-element coset preserve adjacency; signed simplicial Lefschetz sums over every face produce all 336 character values. All scripts and certificates were executed from their packaged paths.

value.rationale: The flag graph of the Fano plane is a canonical 21-vertex, 336-symmetry incidence object. Its natural first distance enlargement produces a complete integral homotopy transition from eight circles to 48 two-spheres, beyond the high-girth stable range. The exhaustively computed full rational automorphism character and the distinct invariant dimensions for the 168-element collineation group and 336-element incidence automorphism group reveal a genuine duality-sensitive structural invariant inaccessible from Betti numbers alone.
